sso.confirmDelete: Delete the “{{name}}” provider? Users provisioned through it keep their account but can no longer sign in via this IdP.
sso.intro: Federate sign-in with Microsoft Entra ID (OIDC). Each provider's client secret is entered here, <0>encrypted at rest and scoped to this tenant</0> — never shown again after saving. Keep at least one break-glass admin (local password + MFA) in case the IdP is unreachable.
sso.licenseTitle: Single sign-on requires an active license.
sso.licenseBody: You can configure a provider here, but federated sign-in stays disabled until the feature is covered. Import your license in <0>Administration → License</0>.

scim.title: SCIM provisioning
scim.intro: Auto-provision and deactivate users and groups from your IdP. In Entra → Provisioning, set the <0>Tenant URL</0> below and use an <1>Organization API key</1> scoped <2>scim:provision</2> as the <3>Secret Token</3> (create one under Integrations → Organization API keys). Provisioned <4>groups become teams</4>; deactivation suspends the account and revokes its sessions.
scim.mappingExternalId: Map <0>externalId</0> → <1>objectId</1> (not the default <2>mailNickname</2>) so the link stays stable when an email/UPN changes.
scim.mappingEmployee: To sync the HR/employee number, map your Entra attribute (e.g. <0>employeeId</0>) → the enterprise extension <1>urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:User:employeeNumber</1>. It lands on the local <2>employeeId</2>.
scim.secretTokenHint: Generate the bearer token your identity provider (Entra) uses to authenticate to the SCIM endpoint, then paste it into the provisioning 'Secret Token' field.
scim.licenseRequired: SCIM provisioning requires a license that includes it.
scim.secretShownOnce: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.
scim.revokeConfirm: Revoke the SCIM token? Provisioning from your identity provider will stop until you generate a new one.

editor.protocolHint: OIDC (OpenID Connect) is recommended for Entra. SAML 2.0 for IdPs that only speak SAML.
editor.slugHintImmutable: Immutable — frozen in the redirect URI.
editor.slugHint: Lowercase id used in the redirect URI. Cannot be changed later.
editor.samlGeneratedIntro: Give these generated values to the IdP (Entra → Enterprise App → SAML):
editor.acsReplyHint: Entra: "Reply URL (Assertion Consumer Service URL)". Generated from the slug — not editable.
editor.spEntityIdHint: Generated by default. Set this exact value as "Identifier (Entity ID)" in Entra.
editor.spEntityIdCustomHint: Must match exactly the "Identifier (Entity ID)" configured in Entra.
editor.saveFirstMetadata: Save the provider first, then export the metadata file here.
editor.spMetadataHint: Optional: in Entra you can "Upload metadata file" instead of filling ACS/Identifier by hand.
editor.idpSignOnUrlHint: The IdP SSO URL (Entra: "Login URL" in the SAML config).
editor.certPlaceholder:
Upload the .cer from Entra, or paste:
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIID...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
editor.idpSigningCertHint: Entra → SAML Certificates → download "Certificate (Base64)" and drop the .cer here (or paste the PEM). Used to verify the assertion signature.
editor.redirectUriHint: Add this exact URL to "Redirect URIs" in the Entra app registration. Generated from the slug — not editable.
editor.directoryTenantHint: Tenant ID (GUID), verified domain, or "organizations". The discovery URL is built for you.
editor.useCustomDiscovery: Use a custom OIDC discovery URL
editor.oidcDiscoveryUrlHint: For non-Entra OpenID providers. The .well-known/openid-configuration is fetched from here.
editor.backToTenant: ← Back to Microsoft Entra tenant ID
editor.clientSecretHintSet: Encrypted at rest, scoped to this tenant. A secret is already stored — leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
editor.clientSecretHint: Encrypted at rest, scoped to this tenant. Never shown again after saving.
editor.authModeHint: Certificate (private_key_jwt) removes the shared secret: Entra keeps only the public certificate, the private key never leaves this server.
editor.certThumbprintHint: Copy it from Entra > Certificates & secrets > Certificates after uploading the public .cer.
editor.privateKeyHint: Encrypted at rest, scoped to this tenant. Never shown again after saving.
editor.privateKeyHintSet: A private key is already stored — leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
editor.scopesHint: Space- or comma-separated. openid is always included.
editor.defaultRoleHint: Role given to a just-in-time provisioned user without a matching group mapping.
editor.unknownUserRefuse: Refuse the sign-in (don't consume a seat)
editor.unknownUserHint: Users are matched on their stable IdP objectId (externalId claim). When no account matches, either auto-provision one, or reject the login so it never consumes a license seat. A pre-existing account that shares the email is never silently linked — link it by setting its externalId, or it is refused.
editor.authoritativeRoles: Identity provider is authoritative for roles
editor.authoritativeRolesHint: On every sign-in, reset the user to the default role when they no longer match any group mapping (downgrade). Off = roles are only ever set when a group matches, never lowered. The last global admin is never downgraded.
editor.roleMappingsHint: Map an Entra group (object id) or app role to an org role. <0>Priority = order</0> — if a user belongs to several mapped groups, <1>only the first match (top to bottom) is applied</1>; a user has exactly one org role. No match → the default role. Use the arrows to reorder.
editor.duplicateWarning: ⚠ The same group is mapped more than once (highlighted). Each group must target a single role — remove the duplicate before saving.
editor.resolveDuplicates: Resolve duplicate group mappings to save.

collabSpaces.title: Collaboration spaces
collabSpaces.hint: Spaces linked to this project. A space created by Vaks follows the project; a declared one comes from an external tool.
collabSpaces.unlinkConfirm: Unlink the {{name}} space? The space itself is not deleted — only the link in Vaks.

collabProvision.title: Collaboration spaces
collabProvision.hint: Create the space for this project with one click. The space is normally created automatically when the project becomes active — use this when the project is already active.
collabProvision.archiveConfirm: Archive the {{name}} space for this project? It becomes read-only; content is kept.
collabProvision.archiveConfirmSlack: Archive the Slack channel and unlink it? Slack cannot delete a channel — archiving is the only cleanup: it becomes read-only and leaves the channel lists, content is kept. The Vaks link is removed, so you can provision again. ⚠️ The channel name stays reserved in Slack: re-provisioning the same project will fail unless you rename the archived channel or change the prefix.
collabProvision.detachConfirm: ⚠️ Unlink the {{name}} space from this project? This only clears the Vaks link — it does NOT touch the remote space (no archive, no delete), which keeps running on the provider side. Use this when the space or team was already deleted on the provider side and archive/re-sync fail. The project then goes back to 'Provision now'.
collabProvision.deleteSpaceConfirm: ⚠️ PERMANENTLY delete the {{name}} space? Google Chat has no archive — the space and all its messages are deleted for good on Google's side, and the Vaks link is removed. This cannot be undone. (Requires the chat.delete scope in your domain-wide delegation.)
